title: Extra Ores Mod
description: This project adds new ores, new items, and more!
body:
# Extra Ores!
in this mod, there are extra ores to play around with and more items to be associated with the ores!

Obsidian items!

![obsidian sword in crafting table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2efa6210d07a9b9a0c05ab87042619e2f3a0e6d.png)

![obsidian pickaxe in crafting table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82ca9aac646a2f8a2d8c70b4c0aba410a09ea616.png)

### And more!

![Minecraft ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6c24bec50158a16bc97da39e1b5bf2f6839e071.png)

To be noted **World Generation** for **ores** is **not working** as of now as it is **glitched** right now.
I just want people to **download this mod** so I can get more **convinced to fix the issue** and add **more ores and items**.
